## 2. Core Practice Areas
1. **Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning:** Autonomous multi-agent systems, custom LLMs, RAG architectures, and predictive analytics.
2. **Data Annotation & Labelling Suite:**
   - Image Annotation (Bounding box, polygon, semantic segmentation)
   - Video Annotation (Frame-by-frame tracking, action recognition)
   - Audio & Speech Annotation (Transcription, acoustic phonetics, intent classification)
   - 3D LiDAR & Point Cloud Annotation (Autonomous vehicles, spatial mapping)
   - Text & NLP Annotation (Named Entity Recognition, sentiment analysis, syntactic parsing)
3. **Cloud Computing & DevOps:** Multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes orchestration, and serverless architectures.
4. **Digital Product Engineering:** Full-stack React, Node.js, Python, and scalable microservices.
5. **Big Data & Enterprise Platforms:** Scalable ETL pipelines, data vector lakes, ERP & CRM system modernizations.
